M4.reason: The brief asks for black metal with a wooden or dark pump and stock. The whole asset is one uniform mid-grey (sides, top and below in every view), with no black metal region and no wood or dark pump region at all.

M5.reason: The brief names no markings, but a shotgun would carry receiver detail, a trigger, a sling point or wood grain. The surface shows only a faint blotchy grey with no panel lines or wear. It adds nothing wrong, but it has none of the weapon's detail.

M6.reason: In lineup.png (A, the asset, beside Valve's B, C and D) it reads as a grey block, not a weapon. It does not look like the game's shotgun or any of its props, so a player would not take it for one of the game's.

M7.reason: The asset lies flat on its back and stands on its origin the same way in every view. The brief names no front, so nothing shows a wrong facing, but it is not a weapon shape with a front to judge.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors. It has 12 triangles (under the 276 limit, twice the median of 138, and under the third-quartile 187). It is a closed box with no open faces, inside-out faces or floating parts in the views.
